controles.affirmation: Resultat net trimestriel de 4 345 M EUR au T2 2026 (+33,4 %) dont 858 M EUR de plus-value exceptionnelle Ageas/AGI
controles.verbatim_source: exceptional items this quarter had a positive impact of EUR 761m on Net income, Group share (-EUR 114m in 2Q25). They included mainly the EUR 858m capital gain through divestment as part of the Ageas / AGI transaction, which closed on 28 April 2026 ... Net income, Group share came to EUR 4,345m in 2Q26 ... increasing significantly by 33.4% compared to 2Q25 (EUR 3,258m) (communique T2 2026, 23 juillet 2026)

controles.affirmation: Elements non operationnels de 1 435 M EUR au S1 2026 (dont Allfunds 372 M EUR et Ageas/AGI 858 M EUR), soit environ 13 % du resultat avant impot de 10 671 M EUR (+21,3 % contre 8 797 M EUR)
controles.verbatim_source: The Group's non-operating items, at EUR 1,435 in 1H26, include mainly the impact of the revaluation of the financial stake in Allfunds (EUR 372m) and the capital gain on divestment in the Ageas/AGI transaction (EUR 858m). Group pre-tax income came to EUR 10,671m, up sharply by 21.3% compared to 1H25 (EUR 8,797m). (communique T2 2026). 1 435/10 671 = 13,4 %

controles.affirmation: Acompte sur dividende de 3,23 EUR par action (+24,7 %) integrant explicitement la plus-value exceptionnelle
controles.verbatim_source: an interim dividend equal to 50% of consolidated net income per share of the first half of 2026 (EUR 6.45), hence EUR 3.23 per share. It includes the exceptional capital gain related to the Ageas/AGI transaction ; 2026 interim dividend: EUR 3.23 +24.7% (communique T2 2026)
In the first half of 2026, NBI came to EUR 28,147m, up by 10.2% (+9.2% csr) compared to the first half of 2025 (communique T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Charges d'exploitation IPS +34,2 % au T2 2026 et +33,7 % au S1 du fait de l'integration d'AXA IM ; revenus IPS 3 922 M EUR (+30,0 %)
controles.verbatim_source: At IPS, operating expenses rose (+34.2% vs. 2Q25) due to the AXA IM integration ; They were up by 33.7% at IPS, due to the impact of the integration of AXA IM ; IPS's NBI rose very strongly (+30.0% vs. 1H25) to EUR 3,922m (communique T2 2026). A perimetre et change constants : opex IPS +3,4 % au trimestre et +4,0 % au semestre, ce que l'ATT mentionne bien comme nuance.

controles.affirmation: Cout du risque annuel de 2 999 M EUR en 2024 a 3 350 M EUR en 2025 ; taux de couverture des creances douteuses de 69,7 % fin 2024 a 66,9 % fin 2025
controles.verbatim_source: TOTAL COST OF RISK FOR THE PERIOD (3,350) (2,999) +11.7% ; The coverage ratio was at 66.9% at 31 December 2025, compared with 69.7% at 31 December 2024 (URD 2025)

controles.affirmation: Les encours ponderes au titre du risque de credit representent 73 % du total du groupe
controles.verbatim_source: The BNP Paribas Group's risk-weighted assets subject to this type of risk ... amounted to EUR 567 billion at 31 December 2025, or 73% of the total risk-weighted assets of the BNP Paribas Group, as compared to EUR 600 billion at 31 December 2024, or 79% (URD 2025)

controles.affirmation: Cout du risque du T2 2026 a 39 points de base, dans la fourchette de guidance de moins de 40 points de base pour 2026 ; taux de creances douteuses de 1,6 % des encours bruts, bas et en baisse continue
controles.verbatim_source: the coverage rate of non-performing loans (stage 3) stood at 66.4%, for a ratio of non-performing loans to gross outstandings of 1.6%, a low rate that has continued to steadily decline over time. On this basis, cost of risk stood at 39 basis points of customer loans outstanding, in line with the guidance of less than 40 basis points for 2026 (communique T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Provision prospective de 95 M EUR au T2 2026 et 155 M EUR sur le semestre pour refleter le contexte geopolitique ; stock de provisions de 18,4 Mds EUR ; qualite des actifs decrite comme tres solide hors cet effet
controles.verbatim_source: In the second quarter, to reflect the geopolitical context, a forward-looking provision of +EUR 95m (stages 1 and 2) was booked under the Corporate Centre. Excluding this impact, the quality of assets was very solid ... includes a forward-looking provision of EUR 155m (EUR 60m at 1Q26 and EUR 95m as of 2Q26) to reflect the geopolitical context ... the provision stock stood at EUR 18.4 bn (communique T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: France 26 % du produit net bancaire, reste de l'Europe 50 %, reste du monde 24 % au 31 decembre 2025
controles.verbatim_source: economic conditions in France (26% of the Group's revenues at 31 December 2025), other countries in Europe (50% of the Group's revenues at 31 December 2025) and the rest of the world (24% of the Group's revenues at 31 December 2025) (URD 2025, Facteurs de risque)
controles.correction_proposee: Substance exacte, mais le verbatim cite dans l'ATT ecrit 'net banking income' la ou le document ecrit 'the Group's revenues' et 'other countries in Europe' la ou l'ATT ecrit 'other European countries' : aligner la citation sur le texte source.

controles.affirmation: Le groupe a pris en compte les nouvelles dispositions du reglement CRR a compter du 1er janvier 2025
controles.verbatim_source: As a reminder, the Group has taken into account the new provisions of the CRR Regulation as of 1 January 2025 with a presentation of a phased-in risk-weighted assets including transitional arrangements as defined in Articles 465, 468 and 495 of such Regulation. (URD 2025)

controles.affirmation: Coefficient d'exploitation de 59,3 % au S1 2026 (-1,3 point) contre un objectif de moins de 56 % en 2028
controles.verbatim_source: ratio came to 59.3% (-1.3 points vs. 1H25), in line with the trajectory target of less than 56% by 2028 ; A cost-income ratio projected at about 60% in 2026, and then below 56% in 2028 (communique T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: CET1 a 13,0 % au 30 juin 2026 (+20 pb sur le trimestre), objectif de 13 % fixe pour 2027 deja atteint ; generation organique nette +30 pb au T2 ; 63 Mds EUR d'encours ponderes cedes via SRT et assurance-credit pour environ 90 pb de CET1
controles.verbatim_source: The Common Equity Tier 1 ratio stood at 13.0% as of 30 June 2026, up by +20 basis points compared to 31 March 2026 ... (i) organic generation of capital net of the change in risk-weighted assets in 2Q26 (+30 basis points) ... The Group has thereby already met its CET1 ratio objective of 13% set for 2027 ... the stock of RWA savings stood at EUR 63bn, for CET1 savings of about 90 basis points (communique T2 2026)
